discovery_notes: B417 follow-up 10 of B044 (DLP 2020-2021). New: Chip 'n' Dale OE Feb 2021 four named pins (Acorn, Peanut, Secret, Suspicious), Wedding & Pooh Jan 2021 set (held), two Stitch OE Feb 2021 set, Valentine 2021 LE three set, pirate Chip & Dale Halloween 2021 pin (held as possible duplicate). No holds released. Snippet-only evidence.
